name: watch-pr-skill
description: Native PR review loop, 2.x — drives the Codex and Copilot GitHub reviewers to a clean signoff, then gates the merge. No daemon: the 1.x file bus is retired.

reviewSmall.title: Cold review, small change
reviewSmall.description: Model and effort for a cold review of a small change, written model/effort. The model `default` leaves the model of the call as it was.

reviewMedium.title: Cold review, medium change
reviewMedium.description: Model and effort for a cold review of a medium change.

reviewLarge.title: Cold review, large change
reviewLarge.description: Model and effort for a cold review of a large change.

reviewSmallLines.title: Cold review: small up to (lines)
reviewSmallLines.description: A change of at most this many added and deleted lines against its merge base is small.

reviewLargeLines.title: Cold review: large from (lines)
reviewLargeLines.description: A change of at least this many added and deleted lines against its merge base is large.

fixSmall.title: Review fix, small pass
fixSmall.description: Model and effort for a delegated pass that fixes few review findings.

fixMedium.title: Review fix, medium pass
fixMedium.description: Model and effort for a delegated pass that fixes several review findings.

fixLarge.title: Review fix, large pass
fixLarge.description: Model and effort for a delegated pass that fixes many review findings.

fixSmallFindings.title: Review fix: small up to (findings)
fixSmallFindings.description: A fix pass stating at most this many findings is small.

fixLargeFindings.title: Review fix: large from (findings)
fixLargeFindings.description: A fix pass stating at least this many findings is large.
